chunks: And it was narrated from ʿUmar ibn Yazid, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, “By Allah, I do not know whether my father performed the ʿaqīqah for me or not.”
So he عليه السلام instructed me, and I performed the ʿaqīqah for myself while I was an old man.
ai.seo_question: Can a person perform ʿaqīqah for himself if he does not know whether it was done by his father?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that ʿUmar ibn Yazid asked Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام whether he should do ʿaqīqah for himself if he did not know whether his father had done it at birth. The Imam عليه السلام instructed him to do so, and he carried it out despite being elderly. The narration indicates the continuing relevance of ʿaqīqah even when it was not known or done in infancy.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4712 - It was narrated from Umar ibn Yazid who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (as), "By Allah (swt), I do not know whether my father performed the aqiqah (sacrifice for a newborn) for me or not."
Imam (as) instructed me, so I performed the aqiqah for myself while I was an old man.
